decisions.reason: Because this decorative fabric remains close to the firm's core design and furnishing knowledge, management can keep learning from customer response and refine it further, although its relatively modest prominence still leaves some pruning risk.

This flame-retardant jacquard curtain fabric fits the firm's established contract and functional textile capabilities very well, so the firm is likely to retain and improve it rather than withdraw it.

Although related to the existing decorative range, the wool-blend positioning and weaker market emphasis make it a more expendable line, especially as the firm shifts resources toward stronger and more sustainability-aligned developments.

The braided-structure upholstery and curtain fabric sits squarely within the firm's core competences and its dedicated presentation suggests a launch the firm will continue to develop before considering exit.
